notes.title: Patch v1 in search
notes.notes: Patch v1 in search - adds missing music at the in search level. Tweaked the design of the level. And also added more ships in orbit if you walk inside the ship. At the MUSHROOM MADNESS level, you can pick up armor that was previously impossible to pick up. At the level of the black hole, holes in the ground are now closed, into which one could fall.
